name: Preußisch Oldendorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Preußisch Oldendorf (a red chevron between stars and crossed keys on white).
history: In 1976 the city was granted the right to bear arms and a flag by the Bezirksregierung Detmold; the flag shows the city arms shifted towards the staff on a red and white striped field.

features.role: Preußisch Oldendorf arms — chevron, stars and keys on white
